# MiNator

> MiNator is a bloatware removal tool for Xiaomi and Redmi devices running MIUI or HyperOS. Created by Gabriel Zhechev (gpsn0w). No root required.

## What it does

MiNator removes pre-installed bloatware from Xiaomi & Redmi devices using `pm uninstall -k --user 0`. Nothing is permanently deleted — apps can be restored with a factory reset.

- Works on Mac, Linux and Windows
- No root required
- Tested on Xiaomi 14 — HyperOS 3.0
- Supports MIUI and HyperOS

## Install

Mac / Linux:
```
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gpsn0w/MiNator/main/install.sh)
```

Windows (PowerShell):
```
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gpsn0w/MiNator/main/install.ps1 | iex
```
